WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wood Workshop.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .
   B. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Working Joints 3.3 Surface Preparation 3.4 Project .

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.

   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Adhesives, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
